column1: # matrix_axes.tsv - the survey's product ([GROWTH-SWEEP], growsurv_report.md "Suggested runner shape"):
# construct kind K x quantifier Q x branch position P x core C, each cell nested to depth 250
# (a LIMIT cell: must compile and run its matcher; except Q=plus, which a lower limit refuses near depth 12-16:
# its @250 cell is a stability cell past that limit, paired through plus_edges.tsv) and 251 (its STABILITY twin: refused "too deeply nested"). Lookbehind x
# bref has no cell (PCRE2 refuses it); a bref core on a kind that captures nothing gets a `(a)` in front. Columns: axis name a b (K and Q rows have no b).
#   K: a = the group opener (nest repeats it per level).  Q: a = the quantifier after each `)`.
#   P: a = text after the opener, b = text before the `)` ({A} {B} = the core's two branch literals).
#   C: a = the two branch literals `A,B`, b = the innermost core.
